decision.explanation: The source documents present two distinct claims regarding Diana Laurillard's education. Document 1 (D1S5) explicitly states she 'attended the University of Surrey'. Document 2 (D2S2-D2S16) describes her 'formative years' and time spent studying at 'Chang Gung University'. While Document 1 includes a disclaimer that its references are fictional, Document 2 presents a specific narrative claiming attendance at Chang Gung University. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat all audits as fallible without assuming one source overrides the other, both institutions are returned as valid answers based on the provided text.
